portfolios.name: A: positive on the tuning years

strategies.name: Overnight Hold
strategies.source: Cliff, Cooper & Gulen (2008); Lou, Polk & Skouras (2019)
strategies.plain: Buy at the close, sell at the next morning's open.

strategies.name: Daytime Hold
strategies.plain: Buy at the open, sell at the close, every day.

strategies.name: Market Intraday Momentum
strategies.source: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018), Journal of Financial Economics
strategies.plain: If the market is up from yesterday's close by 10:00, buy for the last half hour; if down, sell short.

strategies.name: Opening Range Breakout
strategies.plain: Trade in the direction of the first 5-30 minutes, stop at the other end of that range.

strategies.name: VWAP Trend
strategies.plain: Long while the price is above the day's volume-weighted average price, short below it.

strategies.name: Noise-Band Breakout
strategies.source: Zarattini, Aziz & Barbon (2024), Swiss Finance Institute
strategies.plain: Trade only when the price leaves its normal daily range and is on the right side of VWAP.

strategies.name: Gap Fade
strategies.plain: When the market opens far from yesterday's close, bet it moves back.

strategies.name: Same Half-Hour Effect
strategies.source: Heston, Korajczyk & Sadka (2010), Journal of Finance (adapted to one fund)
strategies.plain: Each half hour of the day, bet the same way that half hour went on average recently.
